articleTitle: e-Marketing and Service Quality on Repurchase Intention of Online Transportation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Online transportation services offer convenience for the people of the capital city of Jakarta who tend to have a high level of mobility. Two online transportation service companies that are still operating and competing are GO-JEK and GRAB. The purpose of this study is understanding the condition of e-marketing, service quality and repurchase intention of Grab and GoJek as online transportation and to determine the effect of e-marketing and service quality on repurchase intentions. The method of collecting data uses a questionnaire distributed to 100 residents of South Jakarta. The data analysis method used in this study is multiple regression analysis using the SPSS application. The sampling technique is probability sampling techniques - simple random sampling. The statistics center of DKI Jakarta Province on January 30, 2017 noted that residents of South Jakarta who had used online transportation services were 2,185,711. Then determining the size and number of samples using Slovin technique sampling with 10% margin error, so that the number of samples to be examined is as much as 99,995 rounded up to 100 samples. Partially, the variable quality of service dominates its influence on repurchase intention variables with t arithmetic 5.201, while t count e-marketing variable is 1.436. T count e-marketing is smaller than t table 1.984. So, it can be concluded that service quality has a significant effect on repurchase intention while e-marketing does not have a significant effect on repurchase intention.

articleTitle: Evaluation of The Knowledge Management System In Bank CN Using Method of Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Evaluation of the Knowledge Management System (KMS) is conducted to understand the State of KM Portal in Bank CN at the moment and give advice that can enhance the benefits and effectiveness of KM Portal for employees and the company. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate the application of KMS through factor Attitude Towards Using whether it influences Behavior intention to use. Analysis of the evaluation using Technology Acceptance Model 2 method, to analyze the factors which influence the awareness of any user in using KM Portal at Bank. Data collection used survey method by using questionnaire to employee selected department witch total sample 130 respondent. This sampling is a Proportionate Stratified Random Sampling, which is a way of taking samples from members of the population. The Subjective Norm, Facilitating Condition, Usefulness, Perceived Ease of Use, Perceived Attitude Toward Using, and Behavioral Intention to Use. In accordance with the processing of data, the State of the current Portal KM is far from satisfactory. These circumstances do not meet the standards of the company so desire to do further development to obtain a perfect score. The results of the analysis showed there are 9 factors influencing and 3 factors not influencing the consciousness of the user to use the KMS Portal.

articleTitle: Mountain Tourism Destination Website Interface Design Based on Classical Conditioning Theory of Persuasion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this study to examine the design of mountain tourism websites based on classical conditioning theory of persuasion. 70 respondents who have ever at least 3 times visited mountain tourism destinations participated in this study. The filler design of customer interfaces' mountain tourism destination website had guided the stimulant design of this study test. The approach of this paper to reviews the value respondent on customer interface and their specific features or attributes. Therefore, the research utilized conjoint analysis based on classical conditioning theory of persuasion to predict the tourists' preferences. The results findings indicate that specific features and attributes of web site personalization especially for mountain tourism destination user interface preferred by tourist. The research has recommended the most effective customer interface design of destination web site based on classical conditioning method to persuade consumer by 7 Cs Framework of user interface. The practical implications for the marketers of mountain tourism destinations can focus on the recommended classical conditioning method to persuade the tourist through customer interface design of website in order to promote the mountain tourism destination development.

articleTitle: Analysis of Quality Factors GO-JEK Mobile Application to Increase Company Competitive Advantage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Nowadays mobile applications have many advantages compared to websites such as simple and minimalist appearance, more dynamic user interaction, and location mapping support. In a transportation service company that launches a mobile application as an intermediary that connects motorcycle riders with their customers, an analysis will be carried out to see what indicators and factors affect the quality of the application, and how the model can explain the relationship between existing factors, using the method factor analysis and regression analysis methods. The conclusion of the research that has been done is that there are 3 (three) factors that determine the quality of the application. These three factors are system and information, user impact, and promotion. These three factors have proven to have a positive impact on competitive advantage in terms of customer satisfaction, from the driver's side it also provides new employment opportunities for business partners, applications in the transportation sector are expected to be alternative solutions for public transportation in major cities and become examples of implementation green information technology.

articleTitle: Consumer Preferences for the e-CRM Interface of an Indonesian Venture Capital Firm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This paper aims to analyze Consumer Preferences for the e-CRM Interface of an Indonesian Venture Capital Firm and to give recommendations on user interface for venture capital firm who would like to develop their eCRM. Data and information were gathered by performing interview and questionnaire to 91 customers of the Indonesian venture capital firm. Conjoint analysis was used to explore the output elements of the 7C Framework which resulted on the customer preferences towards the e-CRM interface. This paper recommends a framework for Consumer Preferences for the eCRM Interface of an Indonesian Venture Capital Firm. A survey on a for the website interface of Venture Capital Firm is rarely conducted in Indonesia; therefore, this result will be beneficial for developing Indonesian Venture Capital Firm websites.

articleTitle: Mobile Government Application Success Model: A Case of Halo Polisi
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study has the purpose to evaluate the m-government application called Halo Polisi (in English means Hi Police) and finds out the factors supporting the success of applications with focus on the perspective of public. This study uses the DeLone and McLean information system success model. By using the quantitative data processing method, the questionnaire is distributed online to all respondents who are users of the Halo Polisi application. The result from questionnaire are analyzed using the PLS-SEM. This study shows that the factors supporting the success of the application are system quality, service quality, usage, and user satisfaction where these factors can provide perceived benefits by public.

articleTitle: A System Dynamics Computer Model To Assess The Effects Of Action Games On The Development Of Children With Special Need
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Special needs children have a tendency to play more games than children with development in general. Game play activities are often carried out by children with special needs can be a support learning and therapy due to his players the game has interaction without having to meet with his co-star in person. Starting from these data, this study aims to create a model of the System Dynamics approach. Data collected will be simulated by variables other support. The simulation results of the model will be seen autistic children therapy behavior. The results are then analyzed to create an alternative to the existing model. The benefit of this research is to know the description of game play to treatment of children with special needs. The results of simulation showed that playing games in an average time children with autism play therapy can help improve the quality of children with autism if children with autism play the game in a long time actually showed a decrease.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Factors That Affect The Re-Use of Carsharing Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: People interest in carsharing application keep growing due to the comfort and simplicity it provide. Carsharing system it self offer solutions for common problem that usually found in urban areas like traffic jam and pollution. PT XYZ is the company that providing carsharing through it's mobile application. However, the percentage of user that reusing the application is still low. This study aims to analyze factors that influence user intention to reuse the application using Expectation Confirmation Model (ECM) Usage sample were taken from 231 user who have done at least rent a car once from the application. The data samples were analyzed using Partial Least Square Method (PLS) with SmartPLS 3.0. The result showed that perceived usefulness, satisfaction and service quality directly affecting reuse intention. meanwhile, your confirmation task technology fit indirectly affecting reuse intention of Carsharing.

articleTitle: Evaluation Factors influencing the use Cloud Computing in the Company
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In recent years, cloud computing technology has been widely used by companies. However, they need to consider various factors that influence to decision using of the technology. This study analyzes the factors that influence the use of cloud computing in companies, which are the ease of use, usefulness, profitability and compatibility of these technologies. This study analyzes the correlation between each factor and the use of technology through the Theory of Technological Acceptance (TAM), the theory of the diffusion of innovation (DOI), principal component analysis (PCA) and ANOVA, statistical methods. The results of this study are the ease of use, usefulness, the profitability and the compatibility factors that influence and correlate with the use of cloud computing in the company.

articleTitle: Web-Based Shipping Application for Small-Medium Sized Logistics Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The increasing amount of product consumption has an impact on the increase in the amount of production. The increasing amount of production will also affect the increasing demand for freight forwarding services. The faster a product reaches the end consumer, the faster the economical turnover of a country will occur. However, reality does not always happen like that, especially in Indonesia. The high cost of transportation often weighs on end consumers to buy products. So that there is a decrease in purchasing power from consumers due to the cost of production, which is too expensive. The problem of logistics is one of the crucial things that must always be a concern for all of us. In this study, a web-based freight forwarding application was built to facilitate the integration process between several freight forwarding operators to service the demand for goods distribution from producers to end consumers. The goal is, of course, to accelerate the process of distribution of goods, tidy up the administrative process, and increase the savings in the cost of shipping goods, because the sourcing of resources is integrated and well allocated. So that the difficulty of waiting time can be shortened and used for more useful activities.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Knowledge Management System Using House of Quality Method in Private Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to describe the evaluation of knowledge management system (KMS) using House of Quality Method for several branches of private banking industry in Indonesia. The high-level house of quality matrix was modified and used as a tool to evaluate the ongoing KMS implementation. Additionally, the Infosys KM Maturity Model was applied to determine its maturity level. Targeted result for this study is to form a recommendation for KMS implementation in the organization, especially in the private banking industry. KMS spread to various business field. It becomes an obligation for every organization to manage its knowledge flow and drive it to achieve innovation. As an industry with huge amount of knowledge come in and out daily, banking industry need to take their KMS to another level. By evaluating its KMS periodically, organization may improve the performance, quality and maturity level of its KMS.

articleTitle: Consumer Trust Factors Affecting Repurchase Intention of Go-life Services
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study has the purpose to identify the antecedents of customer's trust for Go-Life, an online on-demand services application in Indonesia. The factors used in this study are based on mobile service quality (M-S-QUAL) framework. The purpose of this study also to analyze whether there is a trust transfer mechanism between parties involved in Go-Life services. This study uses quantitative approach by using online questionnaire data taken from 625 Go-Life users. Data analysis was conducted using partial least square structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM) method with SmartPLS v.3.2.8 software. This study finds out that efficiency, fulfillment, privacy, responsiveness, and content positively contribute to customer's trust using the services provided by Go-Life. Furthermore, the results of this study present that trust transfer mechanism exists between Go-Life users, Go-Life, and Go-Life service provider.

articleTitle: Development of Integrated Tourism Portal
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Information technology is an essential means of supporting the development of the tourism sector. Travelers need a travel portal that can accommodate trips that suit their personality. The study aimed to design web-based portals for tourism businesses to create flexible tourism activities for tourists. The portal is also expected to be able to introduce tourism businesses that are not widely known. This study uses the method of distributing questionnaires for data collection. Portal development using Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Whereas for analyzing and designing portals use the Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) with Unified modeling language (UML) notation. The portal built can make it easy for users to plan trips and help entrepreneurs involved in expanding their business network.

articleTitle: Factors that Influence the Use of e-Faktur: The Case of VAT Online Reporting
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Reformation in the information technology-based taxation system was carried out by the Directorate General of Taxation to encourage a breakthrough by updating e-faktur. This research aims to examine the Effect of Perception of Self-Efficacy Perception, Perception of Usefulness and Perception of Ease to Use of e-faktur on Reporting Effectiveness of VAT online reporting in Indonesia.The results showed that the increasing Perception of Self-Efficacy Perception, Perception of Usefulness and Perception of Ease to Use of e-faktur causing effectiveness of VAT online reporting increased.

articleTitle: Resolving ERP Issues in A Small Medium Company: A Case Of PT Mega Eltra
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This paper tries to identify and resolve ERP related problems at PT Mega Eltra, an Indonesian Small Medium Enterprise. Although PT Mega Eltra has implemented SAP ERP system for 3 years, several expectations are not met because the best practice implementation is not fulfilled. Thus, we apply soft system methodology to find the root cause of the current issues. We obtained data using interview to six employees. Then, we compare the best practice to the reality and identify the gap between them. Results show that PT Mega Eltra have problems in several aspects, namely project management, business process reengineering, vendor, strategy, training, and communication. We recommend several things to improve the business performance, such as upgrading server, automating third-party applications for approval, implementing customer relationship management and supply chain management systems, integrating HCM applications, implementing dashboard, and implementing knowledge management.

articleTitle: Vehicle Recognition Systems Using Speed-Up Robust Features and Non-Maxima Suppression
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The proposed work aims to implement non learning computer vision method using features detection in real live traffic condition to recognize vehicle by its physical features. The algorithm uses speed up robust features that is invariant to both scaling and rotation of an image. The use of speed up robust features (SURF) technique is based on its capability to correctly recognize images with different sizes and various angles of rotation. The proposed work uses a modified SURF that uses non maxima suppression in finding local maxima in order to point exactly the highest value of gradient magnitude. Object cloning was as well implemented in order to avoid memory violation of the observed and model images and increases the speed of algorithm. The system was tested against several conditions including tested towards finding moving and stationed object from the observed video. Additionally, it was as well tested towards real live traffic with minimum light (at night) and during light rain that increase the noise and distortion level of a live monitored environment. The accuracy result is promising with an average of 90% correctness and average performance of 688 millisecond per frame. The work as well aimed to provide conclusion whether the use of a modified scale and rotation invariant technique such as SURF and non-maxima suppression could contribute positively in the area of live vehicle recognition systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Transportation Reservation Management Module Usage in ERP System at PT. XYZ (a case study approach using Fit Gap Analysis and Technology Acceptance Model)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: A successful information systems application should not only be determined by whether the functions of the system are running properly. Most of the times, the development of an information systems application judged only from the technical side, while there are actually many more non-technical factors like the human resources readiness, organizational support, and so on that could affects the level of user's acceptance towards an information systems application. Therefore, this research will uncover the gaps in Transportation Management System (TRM), a car-rental application of XYZ Transportation Solution's at PT. XYZ, by using Fit & Gap Analysis for further improvement in the future. Furthermore, this research will also uncover the factors that affect the degree of user acceptance towards that system by using Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) methodology. The result of this research show there are several gaps on the TRM. The factors of Perceived Ease of Use significantly influenced the factor intention to use.

articleTitle: Reducing Interbank Money Transfer Cost for Personal and Small Businesses using Rational Consumer Behavior Analysis: Case Study of Flip.id
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In Indonesia, interbank money transfer amount and volume are very large. For each interbank money transfer, customer are charged with same transfer fee, regardless the transfer amount. For customer with low and middle economy level, they found the transfer fee quite a burden to deal with when they need to do interbank money transfer for several times per month with small amount. Flip.id came with the offer to do interbank money transfer free of charge for limited amount per day. The purpose of this study is to identify the reason of customers to use Flip.id services based on rational consumer behavior analysis. According to this study, it is known that the efficiency of using the application with significant cost reduction and the easiness of getting/spreading the information of transfer order that been done, become a major factor on why customer chose Flip.id to do interbank money transfer.

articleTitle: Emotional Speech Classification Application Development Using Android Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) has become popular as it is believed to be able to improve company performance. One of the features of CRM are customer satisfaction level analyses. It is a verbal communication means of sending or receiving information. There are several intonations spoken during verbal communication that reflect the emotional state. Therefore, it can be used to get information regarding the level of customer satisfaction. Sound is one type of digital data that can be processed for an emotional state of classification. In this research, the authors decided to develop a mobile application that is integrated with machine learning to record a sound and classify it into a particular emotional state. This application is believed to be able to improve the user experience and simplify the installation to improve communication engagement.

articleTitle: The Activity and Functionality of Social Media in Business Process: A Systematic Literature Review Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In today's digital world, social media have changed and evolved a lot to match the needs of their user since the beginning of they are be launched. The rapid expansion of the internet drive social media as a new collaborating tool to create modify, share many things to the community. This phenomenon has become ubiquitous for a major part of activities in our live. Hence, this era calls itself a network society. Yet, many organizations feel social media as barrier because they don't understand what it is, the functionality of social media and how to build engagement with it and learn, but lately there has been a shifting of functionality on social media platform. Social medias are deploying new roles to gauge organization's performance, advertise, and promote their sites. Considering the pros and cons of social media in many business sectors, in this paper we try to identify various social media's activity and functionality which can be the exploration for future study that use social media as an interactive partnership channel media that facilitate the creation and collaboration via virtual communities. This research uses systematic literature review approach which screening paper published in 2010-2017. The result shows that the classification functionalities of social media that can support organization business process to be up to date with today's shifting era.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Cache Implementation at Physical Storage Layer for Virtualization Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Storage was the major challenge for the overall performance in virtualization environment which also define overall user experience. One solution to overcome the performance problem in storage without having to upgrade the physical storage that requires a lot of costs is to use the cache solution. Its implementation can be seen from the perspective of 3 layers. Previously, only cache solution at layer 2 and 3 that support read-and-write cache (write-back mode), while layer 1 approach was limited to read-only cache (write-through mode). The development of technology introduced new model of storage controller that equipped with write-back function for cache. The experimental tests performed within the scope of this paper try to identify the potential performance improvement of using layer 1 cache at the storage layer (write-back mode) on VMware-based virtualization environment. The test results showed that the layer 1 cache can also be relied-on, from the composition implemented within the tests using SSD media, the performance improvement was up-to 4.71 times compared with the baseline score (a condition without cache acceleration).

articleTitle: Assessing High School Students Readiness for Mobile Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Learning activities has evolved into the next level. Using Mobile technology and its application, students can acquire knowledge and learn new skills. Mobile technology offers a different set of rules to learn and change how students can learn. Nevertheless, there also a challenge to utilize mobile learning. Some factor has implication for the effectiveness of learning using mobile learning. This paper will evaluate the readiness factor towards students' intention for using mobile learning. There are self-efficacy, computer playfulness, subjective Norm, perceived enjoyment and Content quality. The survey was conducted with respondents from high school students. PLS-SEM was used to analyze those factors. The result show that self-efficacy and perceived enjoyment are significant factor for readiness students to use mobile learning.

articleTitle: The Risk Factor of Online Transportation System for Female Passenger in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Reflecting the rapid evolution in transportation, Online Transportation System is growing swiftly in Indonesia. In this line, GoJek is one of the most famous Online Transportation Companies (OTC). As this backdrop, early research reported that single female used the Online Transportation System frequently. In the other angle, passenger's safety, especially for female passenger, has become issues. In this scope, several new findings reported the victim of female passengers. From that lesson, National Police advises the OTC to perform the physiological test for the driver due to security concern. Therefore, the research explored the relationship between the risk factor of the online transportation system for female passenger. In this study, SPSS is used to find the correlation bivariate function and to explain how extent the correlation of risk factor with the passenger background is. In this frame, the research involved 408 respondents of female customer online transportation passenger. Ultimately, fourteen significant correlations are obtained between respondent background and risk factor. The significant factor found contributes to the novelty and valuable for future research.

articleTitle: Improving Warehouse Layout and Allocation Optimization in Catering Services Company
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study aims to find out and provide suggestions about improving the layout and optimizing product placement allocation for the inventories in the warehouse of a catering services company. The method used in this study is quantitative research methods and the type of research is descriptive research. The data collection method using observations and interviews, and the data characteristic are primary and secondary data. Time Horizon in this study using a cross-sectional. Data analysis used ABC Class-Based and Linear Programming method with LINGO Software version 18.0. The results of research conducted at PT Aerofood ACS warehouse is product classification using ABC Class-Based. The products are divided into three classes, class A namely rice, and monouse, class B are soy sauce & sauce, coconut milk, and milk, and class C are tissue, sugar, and tea. For product placement allocation using Transportation method with Linear Programming approach. The results obtained are changes in the space used to store all products. The smaller overall number of pallets and shelves that should visit affects the length of time taken to collect the products. Based on these results, managers should use the ABC Class-Based and Transportation methods for optimizing allocations at a catering services company.

articleTitle: Prototype Development For Online Reservation System in Barbershop and Salon Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The aim of this research is to analyze and design an online Barbershop and Salon reservation system that suits the needs of its users, Owners and Customers. On the other hand this system can reduce waiting time for each barbershop and salon. The methodology used to analyze system requirements is to compile a list of questions and disseminate with online Google docs and analyze using partial correlation. The data obtained is then processed to get an overview of the need for this system to be developed. As a result of this research, the Online Reservation System is suitable for use to reduce customer waiting time. Based on our research, it can be concluded that the majority of respondents who go to a salon or Barbershop are young people aged between 21 and 30 years (52%) or aged between 17 and 20 years (43%) with the student profession (85%). We designed a system of online reservation systems on barbershop and salon based on the Web.

articleTitle: Item Rating and Football Score Priori Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Attempts have been made to resolve various prediction issues relating to recommender system algorithms. In everyday life, there is a lot of need to predict something. For example, when you want to determine which items someone wants to buy or estimate the results of football matches or predict the rating of a movie. It's better if we can sell something that is in accordance with the wishes of the customer. Therefore, algorithm predictions are needed that can produce predictions accurately and precisely. In this paper, algorithm predictions are presented with prior data concepts, where data will be divided into 2 parts, training and testing dataset. There are 5 stages in the Priori Prediction (PP) algorithm starting from the data input process, checking the similarity of data, calculating using the difference function, calculating the predictive score, then evaluating using MAE.PP algorithm is also compared with other recommender system algorithms, which are collaborative filtering, cosine similarity, and content-based filtering in experiments and evaluations. The test results show that the proposed algorithm has satisfactory performance compared to other recommender system.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Fintech on Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Disruptive innovation related modern information systems has recently altered the ways the companies do their businesses and it has positive impacts to those that are willing to adapt to it. The fast development of fintech startups on creating payment gateway and peer-to-peer (P2P) lending applications is one of examples for the modern disruptive innovations affecting to traditional financial business. The problem arises when the digital disruption affects the bank’s business models due to change in customer trends with additional impacts to conventional companies. This paper presents the quantitative approaches like statistical hypothesis testing and analysis of regression using convenient random sampling for better analyzing the impacts of fintech on conventional banking industry in Indonesia. A number of important and realistic variables, such as customer satisfaction, net promotion score, promotion, ease of use, etc., were considered in this research in order to find a variety of the value propositions that dominantly influence to the adoption of fintech or banking products. The results show that the banks have been disrupted by the payment fintech since the emergence of fintech companies in around 2015, mainly due to superior value propositions, like promotion with standardized beta value of 0.349 and wide range of merchants with 0.153, respectively. In addition, the fintech startups have digital strategies on adopting a customer-centric mindset and developing a product that gives their customer a high customer satisfaction. However, in the current time, P2P fintechs do not have that significant disruption to the banks, mainly due to the fact that the customers consider more on safety reasons.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis using Sentiwordnet and Machine Learning Approach (Indonesia general election opinion from the twitter content)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The computational process of identifying and categorizing opinions that are expressed in the piece of text could be employed to determine information insight and the writer's opinion toward a particular topic. Most sentiment analysis employed for English text. Contrarily, a plethora method for sentiment analysis has been reported that the task stayed an interesting question for Indonesian text. The invention of machine learning models and broad accessibility of Twitter data on previous years have derived many researchers to take a machine learning model to resolve the sentiment analysis problem. The objective of this study is to build a sentiment analysis model using Sentiwordnet and machine learning for Indonesia general election opinion in Indonesian text from the twitter content. The data of the tweet was taken namely, the username, and the tweet itself. The theme of the tweet was the topic related to the 2019 general election figures, namely Joko Widodo and Prabowo Subianto. The period of data collection was November 13, 2018, to January 11, 2019, during the campaign period. The tweet was in Indonesia language. The result revealed sentiment analysis with the Naïve Bayes classification method showed 74.94% accuracy for Joko Widodo topic, while 71.37% accuracy for Prabowo topic.

articleTitle: Robust Crypto-Governance Graduate Document Storage and Fraud Avoidance Certificate in Indonesian Private University
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In this study, we considered crypto-governance as a solution for critical problems in private university management: fraud avoidance diplomas, transcripts and diploma supplement. To avoid fraud, it can be done by blockchain technology by the use of University, Company, Traceability, Profit and Policy-making of crypto-governance. Crypto-governance is able to use IBM using hyperledger fabric protocol and private blockchain network. Muhammadiyah Tangerang University (UMT) saved the graduate documents storage manually by human resources. Moreover, it would be wasting time for many tasks, for example when staffs searched database, they would consume a lot of time and the graduate documents were vulnerable to damage in the disaster. Based on the problems above it would face the research questions; how did we keep the graduate documents storage secure and how it could be authentic guaranteed? Blockchain technology with distributed ledger and consensus is considered to overcome this problem. There were 5 steps taken in this research starting from discussing, literature review, analyzing, learning blockchain technology, creating system model and making a conclusion. The conclusions of this study were expected that the data of graduate students could find faster, easily and authentic guaranteed.

articleTitle: Examination of the Factors Contributing To Financial Technology Adoption in Indonesia using Technology Acceptance Model: Case Study of Peer to Peer Lending Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Purpose of this research is to explores the factors that influence the intention to adopt Peer to Peer Lending Service Platform based on the Technology Acceptance Model with trust, credibility, perceived benefit, and perceived risk as additional factors. Structural Equation Model used as statistical test with SmartPLS 3.0 software. The sampling technique is quota sampling. Data source in this research is primary data with 1000 respondents who have accessed fintech Peer to Peer lending also using services provided recently. The results of statistical analysis using PLS-SEM demonstrated that perceived benefit, trust, usefulness and ease of use had significant impect to the intention to choosing fintech lending services.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Marketing (social media and email marketing) and its Impact on Customer Engagement in Purchase Intention: a case study at PT. Soltius Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Along with the development of Internet and technology users in Indonesia, one of the marketing approaches that can be use by company to approach customers is digital marketing, while social media and email marketing are digital marketing tools that the most suitable for Indonesia market nowadays. Beside of the easiness and robustness, social media and email marketing are digital marketing tools that have correlation and effectively building customer engagement. A company that can build a good engagement with customers will have a higher purchase intention compare with company who do not have a good customer engagement. On the other hand by using digital marketing tools it will provides several benefits for a company such as easy access to promote their product and build relationship with customers, suppress the expenditure, also effecting on the increase of sales volume. PT. Soltius Indonesia as ICT (Information and communications technology) company, will be the object on this research to determine the relation within social media, email marketing, customer engagement, and purchase intention inside the company, this research conducted by researchers to be able to find the theoretical confirmation among variables and find suitable implication to maximize the result of the research, that can be use by companies in general for the long term cause. This research conducted on 100 respondents and distributed through online questionnaire. Respondents are potential buyer of PT. Soltius Indonesia which already contacted via chat box (Jivochat). SEM-PLS method used to determine the effect and correlation of each variables, which calculated with Smart PLS v3.2.7 as statistical tool. The main objective of this research is to determine the impact of digital marketing especially social media and email marketing on how this tools give an effect to customer engagement, which will also give an impact to purchase intention.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Market Segmentation Based On The Antecedents Of Customer Satisfaction and Customer Retention
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The "grow and thrive" of e-commerce players in Indonesia and very diverse nowadays customers are causing the intense competition among the players and therefore effects on low customer retention rate. The purposes of this research are to determine the influence of psychographic factors towards customer satisfaction and customer retention in ecommerce, and secondly to identify e-commerce customer segmentation based on the psychographic and demographic factors. This is an associative-descriptive research where the data is collected through questionnaire distributed to 411 respondents with analysis methods used are Path Analysis, Cluster Analysis, and Cross-tabulation. The research result shows that all the independent factors influence customer retention through customer satisfaction, and based on those factors, there are 3 customer segments of e-commerce, i.e. The Functional Shopper, The Credibility-Matters Shopper, and The Money-Dietary Shopper.

articleTitle: Impact of IT Leadership on Transformation of the Role of IT in An Organization: Case Study of the Directorate General of Taxes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)

authors.preferredName: Muhammad Sidratul Muntaha Al Mutawakkil Alallah

abstract: The opportunities from the application of Information Technology (IT) was taken by the Directorate General of Taxes of the Ministry of Finance as the tax authority institution to make various innovations to increase tax revenues. The success of the innovations made by the Directorate General of Taxes was marked by its achievement of receiving the “Digital Transformer of the Year” award from The International Data Corporation. Behind this achievement, there was a large contribution from the TTKI Director who also won the best CIO award from SWA Magazine in 2015 and iCIO Community in 2017. This research is used qualitative approach to identify the transformation of the role of IT and analyse how the IT leadership approach can bring the changes in the role of IT in Directorate General of Taxes. Data was collected through exploratory literature review and semi-structured interview. The informants are CIO of Directorate General of Taxes and Head of Sub Directorate of Information System Analysis and Evaluation, that was selected based on purposive sampling method. From the results and analyses through coding method, there are several IT leadership approaches in making changes to the role of IT from support quadrant into a strategic quadrant. The approaches are continuous innovations, risk taker, fast learner, technology-oriented, and collaboration. From there, lesson learned were obtained, such as the importance of an IT leader who understand business and the need for collaboration with other parties.

Author Keywords: transformation of the role of IT

articleTitle: The Enhancement of Learning Management System in Teaching Learning Process with the UTAUT2 and Trust Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The use of the Learning Management System (LMS) in the teaching learning process in the university has been widely used, but the intensification of the use of the LMS to become a culture in the universities has its own challenges. The main objective of this study is how to find the factors that influence the behavior of lecturers when receiving and using the LMS. This study uses the UTAUT 2 and Trust method to identify the factors that influence the acceptance and use of LMS for university lecturers. The data was collected and analyzed using SEM-PLS. The results of this study indicate that performance expectancy, habit and trust have the significant influence on the acceptance of the application (behavioral intention), while habit and behavioral intention are the influential factor in the use of the application (use behaviour).

articleTitle: Empowering Women Through Peer to Peer Lending: Case Study of Amartha.com
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Over several decades, Indonesia's labor participation is vastly dominated by males. The problem lies on the women's limited opportunities to access and control the resources, combines with their low skills, lack of education, and ideological barriers that land the women in the “stay in the kitchen” mentality. This also affects economic fields, including digital business fields such as e-commerce. Due to this reason, female empowerment in Indonesia is extremely needed. This paper focuses on a case study of a fintech service in Indonesia called Amartha.com. Amartha is a peer-to-peer lending service that also contributes to the women empowerment. The research is conducted by performing interviews involving Amartha.com's lenders and borrowers as well as literature study. The authors found that Amartha has succeeded in increasing women's income, creating new jobs, improving community planning and organizational experience, and building skills.

articleTitle: Push, Pull, and Mooring Evaluation of User Switching Intention from Social Commerce to E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Social commerce is widely used for people who like to socialize while shopping online. However, currently shopping on social commerce has some risk such as especially for security since social commerce platform could not cover end-to-end online transaction process in its platform. Ecommerce on the other hand, could still be relied on to ensure the security and ease of transactions. This characteristic might encourage user to switch from social commerce to e-commerce. This study aims to understand complete understanding of factors that influence user to migrate with push-pull-mooring (PPM) model. The model was used the evaluate the factor the drive user to leave social commerce (push factor), the factor that attract user to migrate to e-commerce (pull factor) and factor that can facilitate or hinder the buyer to switch (mooring factor). This study uses a quantitative approach with collecting data using an online survey filled by 1,271 consumers who have shopped online through social commerce and ecommerce. The process of data analysis uses PLS-SEM with SmartPLS (v. 3.2.8). The results of this study indicate that push factors including familiarity have a positive influence in encouraging consumers to leave social commerce, while the pull factor consists of a security concern and ease of use that positively influence consumers in using e-commerce. Meanwhile, mooring factors which consist of hedonic motivations, habit, and facilitating conditions positively influence the intention to switch.

articleTitle: An Innovative Project Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This paper describes an innovative web based Project Management System that adds to the set of established tools of project management. The system is designed to handle a number of very large projects. It is based on robust open source systems and frameworks. In addition to the basic features such as Network Diagram, Critical Path Method (CPM), Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT), Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), Gantt Chart etc., the system integrates with Geographical Information System (GIS.) This integration enables the system to record activities of the project in graphic detail on GIS map with geo-coded images and to create a digital representation of the entire project roll-out. This digital representation becomes a valuable resource for operation and maintenance on completion of the project. As the project rolls out, the progress can be seen on an intuitive GIS based dashboard. The system provides multiple methods of data entry: web interface, spreadsheet and mobile application. The system has been found to successfully operate with a number of projects and several hundred thousand tasks.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting People’s Intentions in Investing Through Sharia Peer-To-Peer Lending
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Indonesia has the largest number of Muslim populations in the world. This demographic condition has encouraged the development of sharia peer-to-peer lending (P2PL) services. However, research related to sharia-compliance financial technology is still limited. Therefore, this research is expected to fill the gap. This study aims to analyze factors that influence investors' intention to invest through the sharia P2PL in Indonesia. Using a quantitative approach, this study analyzed 173 respondents who knew or registered on the sharia P2PL platform. The data is processed using SmartPLS software with PLS-SEM method. The result of this study shows that investors intention to invest through sharia P2PL determined by perceived benefits, the religiosity of investors, and trust in the sharia P2PL platform.

articleTitle: Collaborative Learning Strategies for Online Knowledge Sharing Tool Within Organizations: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In spite of there are some methods for applying collaborative learning (CL) to boost participation and motivation to exchange and share knowledge, there has been no clear strategy that briefly described to support sharing processes in collaborative-based knowledge sharing tools. Thus, we conduct a systematic literature review to identify recent studies on collaborative-based systems from 2010 to 2018 by using PRISMA method. This study is objected to point out applied-specific strategic approaches in the CL environment for building an online KS tool in a concept of computer based systems. By doing a comprehensive search through Science Direct, Springer Link. And IEEE Xplore using keywords; `knowledge sharing tools', `collaborative learning strategy,' `online knowledge sharing,' `collaboration learning,' the report results from an analysis of some strategic approaches in CL environment for online knowledge sharing tools. Findings of this study offer an understanding of features, user collaboration-based technique, and technology based approach as a strategy for CL to create a knowledge sharing tool within an organization.

articleTitle: “Wisdom of the Crowd” as Personalized Music Recommendation Model for Langit Musik Service
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: We have been witnessing digital music industry has been grown rapidly in recent years. One Innovation which helps this industry improving its customer satisfaction, customer loyalty, and customer engagement, is personalized recommendation system. It has not only been an interesting innovation in digital music service, but also in almost all digital services. Telkomsel, the leader of the cellular industry in Indonesia, would also like to compete in providing“On Demand Music Streaming Service” by launching its own brand, Langit Musik and personalized recommendation system is supposed to be one of the improvements which can be implemented on top of it. Unfortunately, this personalized recommendation was not yet implemented. This research builds model to predict customer preferences for artists in Langit Musik service, to provide more personalized recommendations for each customer. This study applies an implicit preference from the amount of music listening for customers in period of l and3 months, from Mobile Apps and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD). The modeling uses a collaborative filtering approach with matrix factorization method and measure the model accuracy using Receiver Operating Characteristic / Area Under the Curve (ROC/AUC). The AUC value indicates the prediction quality of the model above prediction from random method. In addition, it was also concluded that the matrix factorization method provides advantages in resource efficiency. The contribution of this research is to improve the customer experience, satisfaction, loyalty and engagement to Langit Musik.

articleTitle: Information System Risk Assessment And Management (Study Case at XYZ University)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Information system risk assessment case studies based on information assets that need to be mapped in detail, this case study has been conducted at XYZ University in the directorate of online learning. There is a need for the application of a risk management information system for information asset security and has to be designed to identify risks and problems that exist at the online learning especially. Information system risk assessment must be watched out for because it can threaten the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of online learning activity and through this qualitative research which uses the OCTAVE ALLEGRO framework, critical assets can be identified together with the proposed prevention approach.

articleTitle: Digitalize Your Brand: Case Study on How Brands Utilize Social Media Platforms to Achieve Branding and Marketing Goals
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Changes brought by social media have impacts on brands and users alike. In today’s digital era, social media is not only a means of communication but also a means of self-expression, used by both individuals and organizations. The utilization of social media, especially by brands are interesting to observe. This research focused on question of how social media platforms were utilized by each brand to achieve branding and marketing goals? At present, little work has been carried out regarding this topic, especially for Indonesian brands. By examining the elements of how these brands used social media platforms, hopefully it can enlighten others to strengthen their online brands presence and identity. Using qualitative approach, and case study as a method, this study chose three Indonesian brands in F & B (CHAMBER), fashion (PVRA) and personal (Edho Zell) which represents a brand in products, services, and personal self. Content analysis were used to analyze and build common themes. Data analysis followed three phases of data reduction, data display, and interpretation. The result shows that the utilization of social media for these three brands is still for short-term marketing goals or activations. There is little or almost no long-term relationships engagement in the posts. Moreover, the three brands already knew their target audiences in social media. And although these brands have different goals of social media utilization, they already developed solid brand identity.

articleTitle: E-Marketing Strategy Analysis of Consumer Purchase Decision in Indonesia Online Sports Stores
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study aims to determine the effect of E-Marketing Marketing Mix on Purchase Decisions on online retail consumers of sports product sellers in Indonesia where in this study was conducted at PT. Decathlon Sport Indonesia because this company already has several cabins in Indonesia. The type of research used is exploratory research with a quantitative approach. The sampling technique uses random sampling. The number of samples used in this study amounted to 100 respondents. Methods of collecting data through questionnaires. The data analysis technique used is descriptive analysis and multiple linear regression analysis. The results of the study show that the obtained Fcount is 23,323 with a significance of 0,000. Ftable which is known to be alpha 5% or 0.05 of 0.361. The results of these calculations indicate that Fcount is greater than Ftable, which is 23.332> 0.361 with a smaller significance than alpha, which is 0.000 <;0.005. Based on the results of the t test it can be seen that there are four groups of independent variables which partially have a significant influence on purchasing decisions; 4Ps (Product, Price, Place, Promotion), P2 (Personalization, Privacy), C2 (Customer Service, Community), and S2 (Site, Security). The dominant group of variables on purchasing decisions are P2 (Personalization, Privacy) and S2 (Site, Security).

articleTitle: Integrated Smart Transportation using IoT at DKI Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: As one of the worst city's traffic in the worlds, the transportation network system in Jakarta faces a lot of challenges challanges. The development of a transportation system is still very much needed, which must be based on a comprehensive analysis and systemic approach. The application of planning standards and implementation standards and transport regulations must be firm and indiscriminate. The integrated mass public transportation system must become essential to overwhelm the problems by implementing IoT. IoT opportunities are very extraordinary can be developed for the benefit to the community. Thus, it means promises a lucrative market share is beyond open to DKI Jakarta Province. The participation from all stakeholder is needed to support the development of smart transportation and encounter the agile challenges at DKI Jakarta as a smart city. Thus, in this study, an IoT-based Integrated Smart Transportation based in Jakarta is proposed. In addition, several challenges of implementation are also presented.

articleTitle: Customer Experience Bali Natural Beauty Care Through Social Media
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Sensatia Botanicals is one of the herbal cosmetics brands based in Bali that uses social media in digital marketing strategies as an effort to win the market. This study wants to describe customer experience when interacting with brands through testimonials published on customer social media accounts. This study used a qualitative approach with a netnography method. The research subject of Sensatia Botanicals and object research of customer experience models will be prepared in three stages, namely Customer Touchpoint, Moment of Truth and Customer Involvement. The results of this study show that customer touchpoints put more emphasis on social media Instagram and YouTube. Moment of Truth is based on customer testimonials, the majority of which are positive sentiments. Customer Engagement through views, likes, and comments providing education to customers about product use, knowing raw materials and manufacturing processes. This study contributes to the world of marketing by utilizing social media technology, while academically inspiring customer experience by monitoring public sentiment on social media.

articleTitle: Online Travel Agency (OTA) Data Maturity Assessment: Case Study PT Solusi Awan Indonesia -“Flylist”
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: According to survey that was being held by DailySocial to 2030 smartphone users in Indonesia, more than 91 percent of respondents have booked flight tickets via online with more than 86 percent of them have booked through online travel agency (OTA). Flylist is the OTA that has been created by PT Solusi Awan Indonesia and published on August 2018 with the vision to retrieve 20 percent of the cheapest price that has not been sold by premium and non-premium airlines and reduce the risk of losing the chances of selling, refund, and overbooking processg. Flylist's vision is relatively huge and will be difficult for new system. To achieve it, data maturity and management should be assessed. Paper will discuss OTA theory, framework (DMBOK and other framework by James M. B.), IATA theory and inovation, research data from interviewees, and document study that will be assessed with HESA data maturity assessment.Based on data maturity assessment, we found that overall score is level 3 (proactive) with the result is Flylist can be improved by doing recommended data governance, standards & compliance, data architecture management and NDC theory on customer service contact, communication, and business intelligence system, technology, data security management activity.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Dense Wi-Fi Network Based on Capacity Requirement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Pacific Place Jakarta is one of the largest shopping malls in Jakarta which has a lot of tenants. Some of them have their own Wi-Fi devices. This causes a problem for Wi-Fi connection. If the tenants have some devices operating on 2.4 GHz wave, it can cause signal interference that can affect the stability of Wi-Fi connection. Full Wi-Fi network evaluation is required at Pacific Place Jakarta in terms of signal performance and availability. In this paper, we analyze the current existing network using some network monitoring tools and we propose a solution based on capacity requirement that can be used to improve Wi-Fi performance. The solution is to arrange a 2.4 GHz channel configuration to minimize interference and output power settings. Simulation results show that there is an improvement in download and upload speed after the solution is implemented. The results also indicate the channel usage decrease of the 2.4 GHz channel and the surrounding noise floor level.

articleTitle: Improving Capabilities and Creating Values in Public Services Through Extended Organization Concept: Case Study of Jakarta Smart City
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The concept of extended organization is an IT (Information Technology) impact on organization, where organizations become leaner and more adaptive in facing changes. This concept was used by the Provincial Government of the Special Capital Region of Jakarta (DKI Jakarta) on implementing Jakarta Smart City (JSC) to improve public services by collaborating with other parties. As a government institution, DKI Jakarta has limitations and inflexibility in terms of budget, resources, compliance with regulations in managing urban resources, so this collaboration is a way to create new capabilities and values to support new Jakarta, that is efficient and innovative. The research methodology used is qualitative approach by collecting data through documentation studies and interviews. The result of this study are the implementation of extended organization concept in JSC and what challenges do DKI Jakarta faces on implementing it. The implementation of extended organization in JSC presented in a map of capabilities and values provided by each parties. There are 5 (five) challenges faced by JSC, namely the amount of information that must be managed, benefit management, platform interoperability and change management, knowledge management, and many parties who want to work together with JSC. This research is expected to be a lesson learn for other organization especially government institution who want to apply the concept of extended organization.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Indonesian Teenagers’ Motives for Using the Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: As Internet use becomes widely used by Indonesian teenagers, knowing more detail about their motives for using the Internet is important for digital marketing interest. This study aims to determine the motives of the Internet in teenagers and to examine the differences in Internet motives based on gender, education level, and school affiliation. Data from a probability sample of 756 teenagers aged 10-19 years were represented by students of junior high schools and senior high schools in Jakarta. Descriptive analysis revealed that Indonesian teenagers' Internet motives are status gaining, opinion expression, social interactions, information gaining, pastime, and entertainment. The three highest motives are pastime, entertainment, and information gaining. The t-test analysis revealed the level of education and school affiliation are significant differentiating factors, while gender is not a significant differentiating factor. Internet motives of senior high school teenagers differed significantly in all types of motives compared to junior high school student teenagers. In addition, in almost all types of motives, teenagers in public schools have a higher mean than teenagers in religion-affiliated schools. Teenagers need a complete social media application that provide tools that can represent their feelings, opinions, status, as well fun and entertaining. It has a lot of creative tools, pleasant and interesting interface, and interactive infographic content for news.

articleTitle: Analysis of Crowdfunding Platform in Encouraging Equal Health Services (a case study of Kitabisa.com)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Inequity of public health service in Indonesia is one of social problem that still need attention and comprehensive evaluation to provide complete solution. The citizen in the low-income family facing difficulty to have health treatment even if government has public health insurance for citizen. Unfortunately, the insurance could not cover all health issues and illness, so people must pay for their expensive treatment fee. Nowadays, crowdfunding is easily conducted through a platform. In Indonesia one of the first platform is Kitabisa.com. It helps to encourage easy and transparent fundraising, that in some cases has been helped people in need to get proper treatment and improve their health condition. Thus, this study aims to evaluate if the platform utilization in improving the equalization in health services. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), four elements must be fulfilled as the requirements that the right to health which are availability, accessibility, quality and equality. This study aims to analyze how the crowdfunding platform could provide those four elements. The data was collected by observation in the testimonies and comments on the campaign conducted in the platform. The result shows that the four principles are supported through the utilization of crowdfunding in the platform.

articleTitle: Analysis on E-commerce Purchase Intention and Decision in Java and Sumatra
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The rapid development of internet in Indonesia as a developing country has increased consumer's intention to use internet for shopping online using e-commerce websites. This study aims at better understanding the factors affecting e-commerce intention and decision of consumers in Java and Sumatera island as the most dominant e-commerce consumers in this country. This paper modified constructs in UTAUT2 model based on literature studies and interview results with e-commerce experts, companies and consumers which are suitable with Indonesian actual condition. A model of consumers purchase intention and decision in e-commerce was developed which incorporates factors such as convenience, perceived website quality, social influence, facilitating condition, hedonic motivation, economic reason/price, security, variety, and goods delivery. Surveys data from 340 ecommerce consumers in Java and Sumatera island used in this study and analysed using covariance based structural equational modelling (CB-SEM). The result from the survey shows that hedonic motivation, convenience, and economic reason are significant influence purchase intention while purchase intention and facilitating condition are significant influence the purchase decision for consumer in Java island. On the other hand, only social influence and facilitating condition which are significant influence purchase intention for consumer in Sumatera island. Overall, the results help to increase our understanding of purchase intention and decision using e-commerce websites based on consumers characteristic in Java and Sumatera as part of Indonesia. It also can be very useful to determine strategies to lead internet users to become online purchaser.

articleTitle: Assessing the Entrepreneurial Orientation Model and Linking it with Entrepreneurial Inclination among Information Systems and Computer Science Students in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Ministry of Communication and Information, Indonesia has stated that Indonesia will become the largest digital economy player in Southeast Asia in 2020. This phenomenon can definitely trigger the digital players in Indonesia to choose online business as their career option. Therefore, there is a need to inculcate the entrepreneurial spirit of students, especially information systems and computer science students. This research work aims at analysing the Entrepreneurial Orientation by exploring its components in line with students majoring in information systems and computer science in Indonesia. It also examines the correlation between Entrepreneurial Orientation and students' preference towards entrepreneurship. Questionnaires have been distributed to the information systems and computer science students at 5 different universities in Indonesia. The hypotheses were developed after conducting the pilot testing. By using the cluster probabilistic random sampling, the 1.230 questionnaires have been distributed and this data collection process yielded back with 381 usable responses that were examined by utilizing SPSS and structural equation modelling. This study finally reveals that there are three dimensions under the Entrepreneurial Orientation variable that are risk-taking, innovativeness and proactiveness. Further, this study reveals that the EO dimensions are positively correlated with entrepreneurial intention among information systems and computer science students. This research is one of the first studies that try to exert and analyse the Entrepreneurial Orientation among information system and computer science students in Indonesia using AMOS-SEM software. Suggestion for future research are also proposed.

articleTitle: Data Govemance and Data Architecture for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Data governance is a basic foundation that must prepare to make data management, and data architecture is a fundamental thing in data management. Currently, there is no data management in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia which cause problems. The purpose of this study is to design data governance structure and data architecture for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia. The research method used for this research is a case study. This study used analysis, interview, discussion and benchmark to another government institution (KKP and BAPPENAS) for collecting and processing data. To conduct research analysis from hidden problems, the steps from soft system methodology and PDCA lifecycle was used. DMBOK framework was used as a guide to define data governance structure and data architecture.

articleTitle: Assessing an Information Security Governance Using IPPF in Multi-Finance Company
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: To ensure the performance of a company, at less once a year, the company use external or internal auditor to assess all assets of the company, include governance. One of company governance is information security governance. Multi-finance Company has to report to the regulator about internal audit activities. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) is a financing companies' regulator, subject to Indonesia Law. International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF) is one of the standards for Internal Audit. This research what to list the questions Internal Auditor will ask the IT team to assess them about Information Security Governance. PT.ABC, a multi-finance company, will be used as a case study.

articleTitle: Indonesian Higher Education Learning Strategy Facing Industry 4.0: Program for Implementing The SPOCs Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This paper aims to propose learning strategy in Indonesian Higher Education Institutions toward Education 4.0, This literature review study focuses on the selection of learning strategy with the MOOC models. The choice of strategy was based on the analysis of current issues of MOOCs implementation as opposed to the provision of Human Resource competencies facing Industry 4.0. Those strengths and weaknesses faced with opportunities for applying the MOOCs models that were compatible with the Higher Education environment operation, such as geographical and economic of the community. The result was SPOCs learning model as one model, which can meet current learning needs that are effective, flexible, accountable, and could be run within selected class whether face-to-face, online, blended or flipped class.

articleTitle: Consideration of Fundamental KPIs and Their Relationship with Environmental Protection in New Product Development Using Bayesian Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Setting key performance indicators (KPIs) that influence key goal indicators (KGIs), such as sales, sales volume, market share, etc., in a new product development program of an enterprise is extremely important in management matters. Although there are many candidates for KPIs, no studies have explored the causal relationship between them and KGIs using a mathematical model. In this study, to reduce the complexity of a new product development program and to enable focus on appropriate management, the association between 5 KGIs and 32 KPIs was modeled through Bayesian network analysis based on 250 actual values. The results were further examined from the viewpoint of product development management. Five KPIs that seem to have a greater likelihood to influence KGIs were extracted as “fundamental KPIs”. In addition, we examined which KGIs will be affected by the product's contribution to the natural environment and society, which is one of the KPIs. Extracting the fundamental KPIs reflecting the actual situation more deeply and exploring the key points for their management is required. This is done by further narrowing down KGIs and KPIs based on the results and increasing the number of actual values. Furthermore, it is required to clarify specific management methods that can balance environmental protection and profits.

Author Keywords: ey goal indicators (KGIs), Key performance indicators (KPIs), environmental protection, project & program management, bayesian network analysis

articleTitle: A Design of Crowd-Based Corruption Prevention System in Indonesia: Indonesia Corruption Map
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Combatting corruption requires not only centralized and institution-based strategy, but must be met with distributive effort supported by abundance of data and technological advancement. This work tackles the issue of decentralized corruption prevention by describing the method of doing heuristic analysis based on multiple data regarding corruption. There are four main data source used for the input of the system in this work, where each data corresponds to a city in a region. All the data are processed into corresponding index, while the indexes will be further used in index interpretation and suggestion mapping process. The output of this system is a decision support system for relevant decision making related to corruption prevention, visualized using Google Map API. This system will be very powerful in the long and tedious war against corruption, when used to its maximum potential.

articleTitle: Conceptual Paper of Eye Tracker Study in Online Impulsive Buying Research
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Impulsive buying is viewed as behaviour influenced by external and internal stimuli. The impulsive buying behaviour resulted in a swift buying decision. This study describes previous studies on how impulsive buying would benefit the companies. Therefore, companies are trying to understand what would induce impulsive buying towards their products. Capturing the behaviour requires some tools such as an eye tracker. This article collects the latest impulsive buying studies. Methods and tools used are explained in the articles. The last part of the article discusses future research to be conducted on online impulsive buying.

Author Keywords: external stimulus and online impulsive buying

articleTitle: Vital Strengthening of SMES in Tangerang Through E-Commerce Adoption Purposeful
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In the era of globalization and rapid development of information technology, companies have to adopt the internet-based business. The internal readiness factors of Small-and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs) have a significant influence on the intention of adopting e-business in SMEs. Further, external readiness factors of Small-and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs) also have a significant influence on the intention of adopting e-business in SMEs. The population of the study was SMEs producing textile products, handicrafts, and Moslem clothing in Cipadu Jaya, Larangan, Tangerang. The method of sampling was simple random sampling with 183 SMEs as samples. The study employed Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with WarpPLS Software 6.0 for data analysis. The findings indicate that the adoption of e-commerce within SMEs was affected by Relative advantage, Compatibility, Cost, Firm size, Organizational readiness, Information intensity and product characteristics, Industry pressure, Government pressure, Consumer readiness, Support from technology vendors, CEO innovativeness, and CEOs involvement.

articleTitle: Brand Post Analysis and Categorization in Automobile’s Instagram Accounts
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study analyzes and categorizes the brand post from official social media of top three market share automobile industries in Indonesia: are Toyota, Daihatsu, and Honda. This study analyzes the secondary data taken from instagram account and we conduct in-depth interview with social media expert to justify the findings. It indicates that each brand post of automobile companies combining caption and picture that fits their communication strategy. Toyota focuses on their post contents that attach on emotional relationship (33%) and current event brand post (24%). Daihatsu focuses more on creating an emotional relationship (35%) and functional brand post (24%), and last, Honda brand post focuses on current event (30%), brand resonance (18%), and product functionality (22%). The result based on the study, companies should be create marketing communication strategy systematically for all channels that they have manage to specific their target market. Companies also encourage to create a creative content such as video, to attract more audiences and increase the engagement level.

articleTitle: The Literature Review of Manufacturing Industry 4.0 Using Mapping Design With GIS Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this literature review is to identify the importance Geographical Information System (GIS) and Industrial 4.0 roles in enhancing manufacturing industry in near future. As the industrial 4.0 concepts has revolved and visible components have surfaced, this paper will use a systematic literature review methodology to assert the crucial elements of manufacturing industries in GIS and Industrial 4.0 concepts for providing a resolution in improving manufacturing industries. In addition, Arcgis online would be used to create a visualization of the proposed map design that shows the potentiality to solve current concerns of manufacturing industries in Bekasi. Along with the evolution of industrial 4.0, it is crucial to grasp on the idea on how to wisely integrate GIS and manufacturing industry location data in-order to track industries sites and monitor activity data ubiquitously. We conclude the analytical elements supported by the evidence and also a proposed map design which could aid the complex decision making and site location tracking of manufacturing industries in Indonesia. By doing this research, the motivation is to convince GIS contribution to manufacturing industry evolution, there are more reasons and evidence to implement GIS to adapt to the current developing industrial 4.0. For further research purposes, this prestudy is the initiation of manufacturing future foresight.
